slides.title: Tigray public employees: pay to resume
Salary payments to begin
slides.body: Getachew Reda, federal adviser, said on X the interim authorities will pay civil servants.

slides.title: Arrears for about 140,000 staff
slides.body: Wazema Radio: only staff who reported to work will be paid.

slides.title: Pay had been withheld
slides.body: Reported disputes over federal budget transfers delayed salaries.

slides.title: Pay workers, keep services open
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Wazema Radio (Nov 11); Critical Threats (Nov 10) · not independently verified
